reviews.comment: Dr. Todd is an amazing prof! She cares about you, wants you to succeed, and gives great feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: This professor is the definition of a KAREN she is sour and gives people a hard time. I have seen her talk to a student terribly, not a good example of a teacher. I do not recommend, stay far away from her. Plus too much reading.
Great professor really helped improve my writing!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This is not a blow off. There is a large assignment that you work on throughout the semester, which is a lot of tedious work. The essay structure is unclear and causes confusion. Lots of reading (Hamlet, Emma, Hunger Games, etc). However, you do watch The Lion King and Arrival, which is fun! Very sweet prof, but be ready to work!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class is so much work. I knew I would have to read/write a fair amount of material, but not up to 6 hours of reading weekly and additional writing time weekly. She gives us no actual structure for our essays, which is frustrating. Lectures aren't engaging. If you take this class, do not take it as a blow-off or on a super full schedule.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I love dr Todd. Attendance is very important for this class but if you show up and do the work you are set up to succeed. She is young and sweet and cares about her students.
Dr Todd is so sweet! She really cares that her students understand the material and participate in class!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Despite popular opinion, I did not really like her that much. Make sure to go to class because attendance and participation matters. Honestly though, I did not feel like her lectures helped at all because they felt very unorganized. She definitely is not a bad professor at all, but there may be better out there.

The most thoughtful and encouraging professor I have ever encountered. She is so intelligent and creates thought-provoking discussions. Her teaching is very interesting and even fun. She always makes students feel seen and understood, never like they are being condescended or looked down on. I wish every prof taught like her, she's incredible!

I loved Dr. Todd. She was kind, funny, gave great, engaging lectures, and fostered great discussions. If you read the assigned books, go to class and communicate with her when you have to miss class, you'll probably get an A with her clear instruction and detailed feedback. I would love to have Dr. Todd again in the future.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Todd really cares about the subject matter and is very knowledgable. She does not make her assignments too difficult and just wants her students to be creative and learn, which is great! She is very nice and always willing to work with her students. I would recommend her for any English class!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was online and asynchronous. There was a group project at the end of the course, and the only time I saw Dr. Todd was when my group had a zoom meeting with her during the project. She was very kind and helpful during the meeting. She left good feedback on assignments and did not grade hard.

I thoroughly enjoyed this class! She taught the class well and I understood what was expected. She gives great feedback when grading your essays. She is fun to talk to about books and Shakespeare. I would 100% recommend this professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Todd is amazing! She gives quality feedback so you can improve your writing each time. Gives extra credit. A very lenient grader, if you put in the work and put in the hours :) you will be fine. Would 100% take again.

Prof Todd is amazing!! So caring, so kind. She reads every discussion post and assignment and gives good feedback on everything. She is there for you when you need assistance and does a great job at explaining harder material. She is just a light and you can tell she is passionate about her work

Dr. Todd is INCREDIBLE. I never thought I'd actually enjoy learning Shakespeare. She genuinely cares about her students and actually applying learning to grow her students. Her class is easy but participation matters in order to truly appreciate and enjoy it. She is one of the best professors and has actually made a difference to her students.
Attentive, fun, overall great professor.

Dr. Todd has been one of my favorite professors here at A&M, and it is no doubt due to her approachability and genuine care for students. She makes classes intriguing and fun by being down to earth and adaptable, and at the end of the day just cares about helping you to better your writing. She cares about you as a person, not just a student.

Dr. Todd is hands down the best teacher Ive had at TAMU! Great lecturer! Really aims to make class a fun experience. Gives in depth feedback and wants her students to succeed! Do yourself a favor and take her class!!!
She's 100% the best choice for a lecture professor. Super engaging, funny and caring. She doesn't grade extremely hard and offers a lot of feedback. By far the best prof you can get.

Professor Todd is a great choice for English. She is young, caring, and loves what she does. I am not a writer at all, in fact I had writing and reading, but she helped me learn a lot and made the class fun to go. There are 4 major essays but they're not too bad. She is a tough grader with essays but she'll work with you if she sees you trying.

Incredible. So helpful and competent. I met with her (outside of her designated office hours) for almost every paper and she would spend 30 min to an hour to help articulate my ideas. Highly recommend. Also kind and funny.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Todd is seriously so sweet. She gives a lot of feedback on your papers that is so helpful. She doesnt just grade, she also critiques which is really helpful so you can continue to write better. Take her! Shes the best!
Seriously amazing! This class was always enjoyable for me even as a non-English major. She's so understanding and helpful. Would 100% recommend taking her.

Dr. Todd is the BEST!!! This was an honors class and it wasn't super difficult. Obviously very writing intensive and a lot of group projects, but I had a great experience! She is so sweet and is an excellent professor. Not only that, she was also readily available to help me with my cover letters for internships! Take her if you!

Dr. Todd made English 104 much more than just a required class. As a STEM major, I had low expectations for this class, but was surprised with how enjoyable this class was. Dr. Todd made the class fun and interesting, and occasionally even brough cookies and treats!

Dr. Todd is an amazing professor. Although I had her at 8am, I was always eager to come to this class. As long as put effort into your writing, you should be fine. Dr. Todd is always willing to help especially during office hours. The lectures and peer reviews are really helpful. Make sure to attend class and be there on time!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Todd is an extremely good professor. I thoroughly enjoyed her class. It was not overly demanding, and there is a lot of opportunity for easy points to boost your grade. But besides her being lax, she's really good at bringing out the writer in people. I was never much of a writer before her class, but she sparked me to really put in effort.

Dr. Todd is so sweet! She is super understanding as long as you show that you work hard. This class is pretty easy, obviously be ready to write. Warning do readings because if she catches your class isn't reading she will give a pop quiz. She gets everyone to engage with new people in class which is something i really enjoyed! Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr Todd REALLY cares about her students. You get to pick the topic of your papers, which is great. She's extremely accessible and will match every bit of effort you put into her class. You do have to come to class and do the readings to participate, but its worth it to get to know her! Take her class for sure!
probably the easiest class I've ever taken. And Dr. Todd will help work around whatever schedule you have.
chillllllli Pepppppa OWWWW!

Dr. Todd is an amazing professor to have for English! Her lectures and group activities are very helpful. She clearly explains content and assignments. She is always ready to help if you stop by during office hours. She takes the time to learn your name and is happy when you visit her office hours. 10/10 would take again!
